'''''Quercus pseudococcifera''''' is a [[species]] of [[flowering plant]] in the beech family [[Fagaceae]]. It is a tree [[Native species|native]] to the west and central [[Mediterranean Basin|Mediterranean]].<ref name=POWO_296626-1/>

==Taxonomy==
''Quercus pseudococcifera'' was first described by [[René Louiche Desfontaines]] in 1799.<ref name=IPNI_296626-1/> It has often been treated as a subspecies, variety or form of ''[[Quercus coccifera]]''.<ref name=POWO_296626-1/>  It is placed in [[Quercus sect. Ilex|section ''Ilex'']].<ref name=Denk17/>

==Distribution==
''Quercus pseudococcifera'' is native to [[Algeria]], [[Morocco]] and [[Tunisia]] in north Africa, and [[Portugal]], [[Sardinia]], [[Sicily]] and [[Spain]] in Europe.<ref name=POWO_296626-1/>
